title: Project Manager And Scrum Master | Telecom Domain
description:
Job Overview We are looking for an experienced Project Manager cum Scrum Master with a strong Telecom domain background and experience working on Telecom Activation, Mediation platforms . The ideal candidate should have experience managing end-to-end project delivery while also driving Agile/Scrum practices , coordinating cross-functional teams, removing blockers and ensuring successful sprint and release delivery. Key Responsibilities Manage and drive end-to-end project delivery for Telecom technology projects. Work on projects involving Activation/Provisioning, Mediation and/or OSS/BSS platforms . Act as the Scrum Master and facilitate Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review and Retrospectives. Plan and track sprints, releases, milestones, deliverables and dependencies . Coordinate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, QA, Solution Architects and other technical teams. Track project progress and proactively manage risks, issues, dependencies and blockers . Ensure timely delivery of sprint and project commitments. Support requirement clarification and coordinate with business and technical teams to ensure requirements are clearly understood. Coordinate SIT/UAT, defect resolution, releases and production implementation . Manage project scope, priorities, timelines and delivery commitments. Act as a bridge between business stakeholders, product teams and technical teams . Prepare project status reports, dashboards, sprint metrics and Agile documentation. Conduct stakeholder meetings and provide regular updates on project progress, risks and dependencies. Support continuous improvement of Agile processes and project delivery practices . Coordinate with distributed and cross-functional teams to ensure smooth delivery. Required Telecom Domain Knowledge The candidate should have relevant experience in at least one of the following areas : Telecom Activation / Provisioning Service Activation Service Provisioning Order-to-Activation flow Service Fulfillment Network/service configuration Activation or orchestration platforms Telecom Mediation CDR / usage data collection and processing Mediation platforms Data transformation, enrichment and validation Integration with Billing/Charging systems

 Required Skills Strong experience as a Project Manager and/or Scrum Master in the Telecom domain. Experience managing end-to-end project delivery . Strong knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies . Hands-on experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies and managing sprint/release delivery. Experience managing project plans, milestones, risks, issues, dependencies and blockers . Strong stakeholder and client management skills. Experience coordinating cross-functional and distributed teams . Good understanding of software development and release lifecycle. Experience with JIRA, Confluence or similar Agile/project management tools . Good communication, coordination and problem-solving skills. Basic understanding of CI/CD and software release processes .

 Preferred Profile Telecom/Communications domain experience is mandatory. Experience in Activation/Provisioning, Mediation or OSS/BSS . Experience working with large-scale Telecom transformation or digital platforms. CSM/PSM or other Scrum Master certification is an advantage. PMP/PRINCE2 or other Project Management certification is an advantage. Experience managing multiple Agile teams or complex Telecom projects is preferred.

Key Skills: Telecom Project Management,Scrum master,PMP,Project Management,Telecommunication,Activation,PSM,Mediation
